description:
Quem somos?

Somos uma empresa de cibersegurança orientada a viabilizar as estratégias de negócios dos nossos clientes através de soluções seguras, flexíveis e inovadoras.

Atuamos no Brasil desde 1998, integrando soluções de última geração reconhecidas pelo Gartner, Forrester e pelos nossos clientes.

Descrição do cargo:

Como Comercial de Cybersecurity, você será responsável por identificar, desenvolver e gerenciar oportunidades de negócios na área de cibersegurança. Seu papel será fundamental para impulsionar as vendas de soluções de segurança cibernética, construir relacionamentos sólidos com clientes e prospects, e garantir que as necessidades de segurança sejam atendidas de forma eficaz. Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com equipes internas e externas para oferecer soluções que protejam os ativos e dados dos clientes contra ameaças cibernéticas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Identificar e prospectar novos clientes e oportunidades de negócios na área de cibersegurança.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de vendas para alcançar metas de receita e expansão de mercado.
  • Manter um pipeline robusto de oportunidades de vendas e conduzir negociações com prospects.
  • Construir e manter relacionamentos sólidos com clientes e prospects, entendendo suas necessidades de segurança e oferecendo soluções personalizadas.
  • Atuar como o principal ponto de contato para questões relacionadas a cibersegurança, oferecendo suporte e consultoria ao longo do ciclo de vendas.
  • Trabalhar com a equipe de pré-venda e consultoria para entender os requisitos técnicos dos clientes e oferecer soluções adequadas.
  • Apresentar e demonstrar soluções de cibersegurança, destacando os benefícios e o valor agregado das soluções.
  • Analisar o mercado e as tendências de cibersegurança para identificar novas oportunidades e ajustar estratégias de vendas.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de marketing para desenvolver campanhas e materiais de suporte às vendas.
  • Monitorar o progresso das vendas e garantir o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas.
  • Preparar e apresentar relatórios de vendas e previsões para a liderança, fornecendo insights sobre desempenho e áreas de melhoria.

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What You Will Do

  • Partner with the managers, directors and technical leaders of our organization to elevate our architecture practices to the next level;
  • Collaborate and support the technical leaders in making technical decisions following our standards and guardrails/guidelines;
  • Help other teams to identify, prioritize, and resolve technical debts and bugs;
  • Foster adoption of best coding practices and patterns;
  • Write technical documentation (with charts, data points and diagrams) and present technical solutions to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner;
  • Help create the architecture principles and present to different stakeholders (e.g.: managers, technical leaders, directors, product managers);
  • Suggest, develop and implement new tools and technologies to solve cross-functional problems;
  • Communicate and elaborate ideas to both technical and non-technical individuals;
  • Identify possible improvements in our overall architecture, perform proof of concepts (POCs) and drive the adoption of new architectural concepts with different teams;
  • Assist in the career development of other developers by providing technical mentoring, pair programming and/or reviewing PRs;
  • Actively contribute to our Backend community by planning, executing and presenting in our Backend Guild sharing technical knowledge;
  • Facilitate communication and alignment of technical backlogs between squads.

What You Will Need

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field OR relevant time Software Engineering work experience;
  • Solid fundamentals in object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, and problem-solving;
  • Expertise in at least one programming language and its main frameworks;
  • Experience in Systems Architectural styles (Monolith, Plugin, SOA, Microservices, Event-driven);
  • Knowledge of Architecture concepts (Software design, hexagonal architecture, onion, clean architecture);
  • Experience with APIs and capabilities;
  • Experience in leading the deployment of systems into production;
  • Familiarity with Cloud platforms and main providers;
  • Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL databases;
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IAC) Technologies;
  • Experience in System Modeling (desirable experience in tactical DDD);
  • Familiarity with Monitoring Tools, Metrics, and Observability;
  • Experience with Agile Framework;
  • Understanding of DevOps culture, automation (CI/CD), and main tools;
  • Knowledge of Quality practices (stress tests, load, TDD, BDD);
  • Advanced level of english.

More about you

  • You´re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You´re motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;
  • You´re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

description:
Overview

Na Swarovski, onde a inovação se encontra com a inspiração, nosso pessoal de caixa são os nossos defensores, que prestam aos clientes um serviço extraordinário e uma experiência de marca inspiradora.

Responsável por auxiliar o gerente de boutique em todas as tarefas administrativas respeitando a abordagem e estratégia empresarial para atingir objetivos de desempenho definidos em termos de vendas, bem como os objetivos qualitativos, incluindo a qualidade do serviço e aparência da boutique de acordo com a estratégia e política da Swarovski.

Sobre o cargo

Você é defensor(a) da nossa marca. Nesta função, e juntamente com a equipa, irá:

  • Realizar as tarefas de Contabilidade, emissão de NF série 01e D1 e enviar os documentos fiscais ao escritório/ Pryor (NF´s , leitura X e leitura z) a fim de garantir o funcionamento dos procedimentos fiscais na boutique.
  • Realizar as tarefas de TI, solicitar manutenção de equipamento ou suporte do sistema quando necessário.
  • Realizar as tarefas de RH, envio de escala de folgas e folha de ponto ao escritório
  • Informar através do email e fax, a chegada de boletos bancários na boutique, e enviar posteriormente ao setor de contas as pagar.
  • Outras tarefas de rotina da área

Sobre você

Você é Um(a) Pessoa De Caixa Excecional, Que Nos Oferece

  • um excelente sentido de moda e uma verdadeira paixão pela nossa marca e os nossos produtos;
  • experiência/forte interesse nas marcas de moda/cosmética/estilo de vida de luxo;
  • uma personalidade fortemente motivada e focada na orientação do cliente;
  • dedicação e atitude orientada por objetivos;
  • vontade de desenvolver a sua carreira e crescer conosco

O que oferecemos

Você pode esperar uma série de benefícios, incluindo:

  • Descontos em produtos Swarovski
  • Programa de Assistência ao Funcionário
  • Licença para voluntario
  • Programas de aprendizagem e desenvolvimento

Sobre a Swarovski

A Swarovski produz produtos à base de cristal de qualidade e habilidade artística impecáveis que trazem alegria e celebram a individualidade. Fundada em 1895 na Áustria, a empresa desenha, fabrica e vende sofisticados cristais, pedras preciosas, diamantes e zircônias fabricadas e acessórios, bem como objetos de cristal e acessórios para a casa. A Swarovski Crystal Business tem alcance global com aproximadamente 2.400 lojas e 6.700 pontos de vendas em cerca de 140 países e emprega mais de 18.000 pessoas. Junto com suas empresas irmãs, a Swarovski Optik (dispositivos ópticos) e a Tyrolit (abrasivos), a Swarovski Crystal Business compõe o Swarovski Group. Uma relação saudável com as pessoas e com o planeta é parte da herança da Swarovski. Hoje, esse legado se fundamenta em medidas de sustentabilidade em toda a cadeia de valor, com ênfase na inovação circular, defendendo a diversidade, inclusão e autoexpressão, e no trabalho filantrópico da Swarovski Foundation, que apoia organizações de caridade que provocam um impacto ambiental e social positivo.

Swarovski é um empregador de igualdade de oportunidades. Oferemos à nossa equipe a coragem de celebrar a individualidade e o orgulho de criar um local de trabalho onde as pessoas se sintam envolvidas, respeitadas, valorizadas, conectadas e ouvidas. Um lugar onde qualquer pessoa se sinta parte da empresa. Todos os aspectos do emprego, incluindo a decisão de contratar, promover, disciplinar ou demitir, serão baseados no mérito, competência, desempenho e necessidades do negócio. Não discriminamos com base em raça, cor, religião, estado civil, idade, nacionalidade, deficiência física ou mental, condição médica, gravidez, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero ou qualquer outro status protegido por lei nos países onde operamos.

Em 2017, fundamos a Hospital Care com o objetivo claro de transformar o cenário da saúde suplementar no Brasil.

Nosso foco é estabelecer redes abrangentes de serviços de saúde, começando pela aquisição de hospitais privados de alta complexidade e expandindo de maneira orgânica. Essas redes, que chamamos de “Hubs”, conectam-se a diversos ativos, formando um ecossistema completo de serviços de saúde, desde laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos, até hospitais de alta complexidade.

Buscamos, através desta união tornar o sistema justo para todos os envolvidos, oferecendo aos pacientes tratamentos focados no seu bem estar, para as operadoras de saúde valores justos e sem desperdícios, aos colaboradores reconhecimento digno e aos investidores retornos sustentáveis, favorecendo toda a cadeia por meio de gestão otimizada e eficiente.

Atuamos para melhorar o acesso a saúde como um todo e nossas ações são orientadas para sermos a melhor rede de saúde privada do Brasil e para fortalecer o sistema de saúde brasileiro, promovendo o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas.

title: Mechanical Engineer
description:
Overview

About Sierra Studio

When you apply to Sierra, you join an ecosystem. We specialize in connecting talented Brazilian professionals with exciting career opportunities in a highly-vetted small community of growing companies in the US. Applying to Sierra seamlessly integrates you into this ecosystem, granting automatic eligibility for all relevant opportunities we offer.

About our hiring partner

Our hiring partner is a consumer product development company. They help companies make new products & bring them to market, leading concepting, design, engineering, supply chain setup & ongoing operational oversight. They have teams in New York City, Hong Kong and beyond. They work with startups and established companies across many consumer categories; from connected hardware & electronics, to durable housewares and in-home goods, to soft-goods and packaging, and everything in between.

Who our hiring partner is looking for

They are looking for a motivated and hands-on Mechanical Engineer to join their team. This position will provide you with the opportunity to work on exciting development projects, helping to create and bring innovative products to life. You will apply your experience in mechanical design, CAD modeling, prototyping, while working alongside cross-functional teams to ensure the product meets all requirements from concept to production.

The Mechanical Engineer will be a member of our hiring partner's Brazil team - The position can be remote but will report to the Staff Engineer out of Campinas/SP. The Brazil team reports into the Head of Product based in HQ in NYC.

The Candidate

You have experience engineering new products and/or handling touchpoints throughout the concept to manufacturing journey. You've either built or supported bringing new products to the world, handling mechanical engineering design, research, testing, prototyping, and validation.

You have experience working with mass manufactured product and are familiar with a variety of materials. You're willing to research, learn, adapt and take initiative but not afraid of taking on challenges.

The Job

As Mechanical Engineer, you will:

  • Help to lead (and lead) development work from product definition through manufacturing.
  • Communicate progress to team members and project requirements for development and manufacturing.
  • Work closely with NYC and Asia teams to communicate and determine direction & solve development problems as they arise.
  • Collaborate with NY/Asia engineering teams to ensure the engineering designs meet client requirements and design intent.

Responsibilities

  • Assist and lead Mechanical Design: Support the design and development of product by creating 3D CAD models, producing engineering drawings, and necessary documentation. i.e. lead mechanical design engineering of a product from inception to manufacturing.
  • Prototyping & Testing: Build and test prototypes to validate designs, including hands-on assembly and working with external suppliers for prototype development.
  • Ensure efficient product development cycle with detailed prototyping, testing, and validation throughout the process.
  • Ensuring designs align with performance, material, and cost targets determined for each project.
  • Collaborate with Teams: Work closely with the engineering and design teams to ensure that products meet functional, material, and aesthetic goals. Communicate with marketing, operations, and manufacturing teams to align on project updates and requirements.
  • Support and Create Documentation: Assist with maintaining and updating CAD models and related product documentation (3D, 2D, etc.).
  • Product Testing: Help conduct off-tool and in-market sample testing, participate in troubleshooting and debugging design issues, and recommend improvements.
  • Learn from Experienced Engineers: Continue to build experience in various materials and different stages of product development while learning best practices from senior and staff engineers.
  • Support Supply Chain Efforts: Collaborate with the sourcing and supply chain teams to help gather information and support procurement of materials and components. Providing technical feedback and assets to support sourcing & supply chain teams, working closely with manufacturing engineers and suppliers.
  • Handle multiple projects and work independently.
  • Provide Engineering Support and Analysis to NY and HK engineering teams.
  • Build inhouse prototypes or scope external partners to prototype designs.

The Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in product development and mechanical engineering. Must have a portfolio with previously launched and manufactured products.
  • Proven experience within consumer electronics /household appliance industry and related industries focused on mechanical engineering
  • Engineering degree preferably Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Highly proficient and deeply familiar with CAD tools (Solidworks, Onshape, or Creo) and prior experience with a variety of prototyping approaches
  • Hands-on experience with prototyping, 3D printing, or other fabrication tools is a plus.
  • Experience with a wide range of materials (plastics, metals, rubbers) and knowledge informing the material selection process.
  • Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach challenges methodically applying analytical skills with proactive issue resolution- creating and guiding root cause analysis and DOE's.
  • Passion for product development: Interest in consumer product design, manufacturing, and mechanical systems.
  • Strong communication skills: Ability to work well with cross-functional teams and convey technical concepts clearly. Strong Presentation skills - especially conveying technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent project management skills- with experience tracking numerous development projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to travel to Asia including Hong Kong, China, Vietnam, South Korea, and Taiwan.
  • High level proficiency in English language- written and spoken

Working Hours

While our work involves coordination predominantly with NY Team, there are meetings that are scheduled outside of traditional 9-6 working hours to accommodate the HK team. We trust all team members to manage their schedules and to take appropriate measures to take care of themselves and their wellbeing.

The Process

Please submit your resume and we will reach out if there is a potential fit.

Our hiring partner is constantly refining their hiring process to be as inclusive, transparent, and respectful of applicants' time as possible. As part of this process, you may be asked to complete a paid assessment based on the role.

Our hiring partner is an equal opportunity employer. They are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. They firmly believe that a diversity of experience, perspectives, and background lead to a better environment for their employees and to better results for their clients. They strongly encourage diverse candidates to apply.

description:
Embedded Linux Software Development Engineer

Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We’re powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you’re interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

Description

As an Embedded Linux Software Development Engineer BSP, you are part of the R&D team, making sure our Linux BSPs and related software offerings for our SoMs (System on Modules) are constantly developed, maintained, and quality improved. The work ranges from initial bring-up, to driver and kernel development, up to build-system, tooling and distro level development.

  • Develop and maintain Embedded Linux BSPs for Toradex' embedded computer modules
  • Eco-system: porting of third party software libraries, develop Software tools and utilities from scratch, Boot loader firmware
  • Mainline selected items
  • Suggest improvements related to products, software offerings, documentation, processes, etc. in order to allow continuous improvement
  • Work closely with other team members in an Agile development environment and participate in technical analysis and decisions
  • Communicate your work progress, coordinate with other development teams, and participate in R&D working groups

Skills

  • Expertise in Embedded Linux: Bootloader and Linux Kernel
  • Excellent C language knowledge and programming skills
  • Knowing OpenEmbedded/Yocto Project build system
  • Knowledge of industry standard interfaces and protocols such as I2C , SPI , UART , USB, Ethernet, PCI Express
  • C++/Python/Bash language knowledge and programming skills
  • Demonstrable Electronics knowledge and work experience: the ability to read and understand hardware schematics and datasheets; to use standard development aids such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, bus protocol analyzers, etc. when developing low-level software which interacts directly with machine registers
  • Familiar with communication peripherals (Bluetooth, Ethernet, Wi-Fi)
  • High-integrity, open, team player

Plus but NOT MANDATORY:

  • Experience with Real Time Operating systems
  • Knowledge of the ARM architecture

What do we offer

  • Agile, globally oriented and inter-cultural corporate culture.
  • Flexible working set up. Working remotely possible (within European time zone)
  • Work on the latest HW technology with early access to major SoC vendor
  • Enjoy a flat hierarchy where you may truly shape our HW and SW offerings
  • Count on a diverse team of experienced HW and SW engineers
  • Variety of knowledge sharing, training and self-development opportunities
  • The opportunity to play a key role in shaping your own work processes and your work environment.
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment.
  • Opportunities for your personal development.
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Todradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

title: Senior Onboarding Specialist
description:
Overview

Marex Group plc (NASDAQ: MRX) is a diversified global financial services platform providing essential liquidity, market access and infrastructure services to clients across energy, commodities and financial markets. The group provides comprehensive breadth and depth of coverage across four core services: clearing, agency and execution, market making, and hedging and investment solutions. It has a leading franchise in many major metals, energy and agricultural products, with access to 60 exchanges. The group provides access to the world’s major commodity markets, covering a broad range of clients that include some of the largest commodity producers, consumers and traders, banks, hedge funds and asset managers. With more than 40 offices worldwide, the group has over 2,300 employees across Europe, Asia and the Americas.

The Matthews Group is a 18 person group within Marex, started by Craig Matthews 35+ years ago. We have a very strong name in the agriculture brokerage space all around the world, and service clients across most all jurisdictions.

We are looking for a bright, hardworking onboarding professional who wants to work in a broad capacity across all onboarding, reporting and accounting operations for the Matthews Group division of Marex.

Responsibilities

  • Onboarding – Handle customer intake and keep brokers up to date with paperwork developments
  • Reporting Functions – Create and Generate reports tracking revenues and customer activity.
  • Accounting Operations – Overseeing all TMG bookkeeping operations, including accounts payable + accounts receivable, Monthly PnL
  • Data Management – Make sure financial data we get is well kept and organized
  • Ensuring compliance with the company’s regulatory requirements under the SEC, FINRA, NFA, CFTC and other applicable exchanges.
  • Adhere to the operational risk framework for your role ensuring that all regulatory or company determined parameters are complied with.
  • Role model for demonstrating highest level standards of integrity and conduct and reflecting Company Values.
  • At all times complying with Marex’s Code of Conduct
  • To ensure that you are fully aware of and adhere to internal policies that relate to you, your role or any other activities for which you have any level of responsibility
  • To report any breaches of policy to Compliance and/ or your supervisor as required
  • To escalate risk events immediately
  • To provide input to risk management processes, as required.

Skills and Experience

  • 2-10 years’ experience* of working within Onboarding/KYC/AML.
  • Experience of working within a sales environment with ambitions to expand their skillset into reporting, accounting operations and a more client focused role.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Experience working in a regulated environment and knowledge of the risk and compliance requirements associated with this.
  • Hum ble, friendly, and a team player
  • Strong accounting and financial knowledge
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Communication and interpersonal skills
  • Computer proficiency
  • Strategic collaborator with insight and agility, able to anticipate future challenges, ensuring operational effectiveness

Conduct Rules

  • Act with integrity
  • Act with due skill, care and diligence
  • Be open and cooperative with the FCA, the PRA and other regulators
  • Pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly
  • Observe proper standard of market conduct

Company Values

Acting as a role model for the values of the Company:

Respect – Clients are at the heart of our business, with superior execution and superb client service the foundation of the firm. We respect our clients and always treat them fairly.

Integrity – Doing business the right way is the only way. We hold ourselves to a high ethical standard in everything we do – our clients expect this and we demand it of ourselves.

Collaborative – We work in teams – open and direct communication and the willingness to work hard and collaboratively are the basis for effective teamwork. Working well with others is necessary for us to succeed at what we do.

Developing our People – Our people are the basis of our competitive advantage. We look to “grow our own” and make Marex the place ambitious, hardworking, talented people choose to build their careers.

Adaptable and Nimble – Our size and flexibility is an advantage. description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
As a Product Manager , you’ll define strategy, lead teams, and deliver digital products that engage millions of users worldwide. Combining data-driven insights with market knowledge, you’ll shape product vision, mentor peers, and collaborate across functions. This role offers high impact, growth, and the chance to influence the future of digital media .

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Product Strategy – Develop and communicate a clear product strategy and vision for IGN’s digital platforms and products, aligning it with the company’s goals and objectives
  • Product Leadership – Lead multiple product teams and drive product strategy for a larger portfolio of products.
  • Team Leadership – Lead and mentor a team of product managers, providing guidance and support to help them achieve their goals and deliver high-quality products.
  • Product Roadmap – Define and maintain the product roadmap for multiple products, ensuring it aligns with business priorities, user needs, and market trends. Make data-driven decisions and prioritize features accordingly.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, editorial, and marketing, to ensure successful product development and delivery.
  • User Research – Conduct and analyze user research to gain a deep understanding of user needs, preferences, and pain points. Use this data to inform product decisions and improvements.
  • User Experience (UX) – Work with UX/UI designers to create user-friendly and visually appealing products. Ensure a seamless and engaging user experience across IGN’s digital platforms.
  • Data Analysis – Utilize data analytics and key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor product performance, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven decisions to optimize the product.
  • Product Development – Oversee the end-to-end product development process, from ideation to release. Coordinate with development teams to deliver high-quality products on schedule.
  • Project Management – Define and prioritize product features, enhancements, and requirements based on customer feedback, market research, and business impact. Collaborate with product managers to ensure that product feature prioritization aligns with the overall product strategy and roadmap.
  • Product Launch – Plan and execute successful product launches, including marketing strategies and user communication. Monitor product performance post-launch and iterate based on user feedback.
  • Stakeholder Communication – Keep stakeholders informed about the status of ongoing projects, milestones, and potential roadblocks. Maintain transparency and ensure alignment with business goals.
  • Market and Competitive Analysis – Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and threats in the market.
  • User Feedback and Support – Engage with user feedback, reviews, and support channels to address user concerns, gather insights, and drive product improvements.

MUST HAVES
- 5-7 years working on technology-powered products as either a product manager or user researcher;
- Strong understanding of digital media platforms, technologies, and industry trends ;
- Proven ability of build intuitive content management systems that meet both internal and external customer needs;
- Experience in building subscription based products with a track record of driving growth;
- Led product development on complex features from 1st to Nth interaction;
- A history of deep and demonstrated understanding of the techniques and methods of modern product discovery and product delivery;
- Demonstrated ability to figure out solutions to hard problems with many constraints, using sound judgment to assess risks, and to lay out your argument in a well-structured, data-informed, written narrative;
- Proven ability to engage with engineers, designers, and company leaders in a constructive and collaborative relationship;
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience;
- Upper-Intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES
- Deep understanding of gaming trends;
- Strong background in app development and design.

PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
- A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
- Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
Overview

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We are scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform how food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils to create a liveable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We are partnering with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders and are growing fast. Our culture blends people-first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.

We are proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil where the real climate impact happens.

About The Role

Role: COO to lead go-to-market strategy for novel mineral-based carbon removal products across agricultural and mining sectors, and to evolve our operational backbone. You will oversee the entire value chain—from mineral inputs and field operations to the internal science engine and technology roadmap. This is a senior role where bold strategy meets operational precision to drive transformational scale.

Location & Travel: Hybrid, with travel in Brazil. Language skills: Portuguese, English (fluent). Start date: Ideally Q3/Q4 2025.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and scale a novel carbon removal product from early traction to national impact in agriculture and mining; a 1-100 leadership role requiring bold strategy and relentless execution.
  • Lead the design and execution of a world-class ERW deployment operation across Brazil with scalability in mind.
  • Translate carbon and climate goals into clear operational strategies and regional delivery models.
  • Drive continuous improvement via operational KPIs, systemisation, and data-driven performance.
  • Collaborate with the Chief Impact Officer, Head of Operations, and VP of Science to align field strategy with scientific standards and operational goals.
  • Lead the integration of field deployment, scientific integrity, and operational scaling to ensure product-market fit.
  • Build cross-functional alignment to ensure the product offers agronomic value while meeting carbon certification requirements; orchestrate the 1-100 scale-up journey.
  • Oversee the sourcing, logistics, and deployment of rock powder from mine to farm; ensure compliance with carbon standards and farmer requirements.
  • Support legal to uphold integrity in carbon reporting and environmental impact.
  • Lead a large and growing team across Brazil and globally; collaborate with Carbon, Science, and Technology teams and strategic partners.

Team & Culture

  • Build a leadership culture that is entrepreneurial, fast, and accountable; turn high performers into high-impact owners.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow high-performing operations teams across Brazil and globally.
  • Champion a culture of accountability, collaboration, and impact-driven execution.
  • Empower regional managers and technical leads to deliver quality projects at scale.

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years of senior leadership in operations, supply chain, or agribusiness in Brazil and in high-growth or startup contexts.
  • You have scaled something from messy beginnings to market success—ideally as a founder, GM, or CEO. You know what product-market fit looks like, and how to turn it into category leadership.
  • Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams and building scalable systems from the ground up.

Aeroporto de Viracopos (VCP)!
Responsibilities and assignments

Job Description
Venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializadas em assistência à aviação no país! ️
A dnata Brasil opera em 30 aeroportos, garantindo que todos os voos recebam o melhor atendimento com o máximo de agilidade; nossas equipes são reconhecidas pela dedicação, profissionalismo, ética, qualidade e expertise apresentados; somos 100% dedicados ao cumprimento de nossas funções.
Globalmente, a dnata foi fundada em 1959 em Dubai, possui mais de 46.000 funcionários divididos em 38 países nos 6 continentes, com atuação em 136 aeroportos e auxiliando mais de 347 clientes.
O Operador de Equipamentos ficará responsável por realizar a operação de atendimento de rampa (movimentação de equipamentos motorizados ou não, embarque e desembarque de passageiros cadeirantes, transporte de bagagens e cargas entre as áreas operacionais do aeroporto) em aeronaves com segurança, qualidade e pontualidade, garantindo eficiência no processo e colaborando para a construção da percepção do cliente quanto aos serviços prestados pela empresa no que tange ao transporte de bagagens, cargas e pontualidade dos voos.
Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para o Aeroporto de Viracopos (VCP)!
Responsibilities and assignments

  • Operar os equipamentos de rampa, realizando a movimentação segura de equipamentos rebocáveis no que tange a logística de preparação de box para atendimento dos voos com equipamentos necessários de acordo com a disponibilidade, levando-se em consideração o load fator, turnaroud da aeronave, distribuição de cargas e bagagens nos porões;
  • Disponibilizar os equipamentos de GPU, ACU e LPU sempre que a aeronave estiver com APU inoperante e/ou para a execução do projeto smart fuel;
  • Realizar o transporte de bagagem e cargas entre variadas áreas de cada aeroporto que estão embarcando, desembarcando ou em conexão;
  • Garantir a segurança de todos durante o atendimento operacional;
  • Garantir a transferência das bagagens de conexão imediata (HOT), para as outas aeronaves;
  • Recolher os equipamentos do box após o termino do atendimento.
Requirements And Qualifications
  • Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) tipo D/E.
  • Visão analítica e sistemática, para tomadas de decisões;
  • Disponibilidade de horário;
  • Conhecimento em processo de atendimento ao cliente;
Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura variável para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, rotação e flexão do tronco e esforço físico, locomoção e deambulação para desenvolvimento das tarefas.
Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para condução dos veículos (atividade regulamentada pelo CTB – código de trânsito brasileiro) e percepção auditiva para detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais.
Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Engenheiro de Projetos role at Stoneridge .

Since 1965, Stoneridge has designed and manufactured advanced, award-winning technologies including driveline and transmission actuation systems, vision systems, emissions control systems, safety systems, and security and monitoring systems for vehicle OEMs in the commercial vehicle, automotive, off-highway and agricultural vehicle markets. We’re focused on the areas of greatest market need – both today and tomorrow. title: Upstream Bioprocess Scale-up Engineer Specialist
description:
Overview

Braskem, a global leader in the production of bio-based materials, is committed to reducing the carbon intensity of its products through development of technology utilizing bio-based feedstocks. In addition to its existing biotechnology research center in Campinas, Brazil, Braskem has recently opened a new renewable research and development facility in Lexington, MA. These two state-of-the-art facilities bring together scientists and engineers from a variety of disciplines to ideate and develop novel technologies for the production of bio-based chemicals and materials.

Role Description

Braskem Innovation and Technology is seeking an exceptional upstream bioprocess engineer for to scale-up of emerging technologies in the area of bio-based chemicals via fermentation processes. The candidate will work closely with the fermentation development team and have primary responsibility for commercial process design, ensuring technical risks are addressed and mitigated in the scale-up from lab to pilot/demo phases. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in fermentation scale-up with experience in implementation of new technology at industrial scale and comfort working closely with innovative teams from research and development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Synthesize the upstream conceptual process design for fermentation-based technologies emerging from discovery teams in lab. This includes all steps from feed preparation, seed train, and fermentation sections of the flowsheet.
  • Work closely with the fermentation development team to guide experimental work with a view toward the commercial process design, and ensure relevant technical targets are set based on commercial process economics.
  • Guide the planning of the pilot plant testing program according to the conceptualized commercial design to ensure the key risks are mapped and mitigate as the technology progresses through scale-up.
  • Build strong relationships while working closely with the firms operating or constructing the pilot plant fermentation units.
  • Generate the technology transfer package in collaboration with the fermentation development team for upstream section of the bioprocess. Serve as the fermentation process expert during pilot and demo testing, being present onsite for extended campaigns.
  • Support process safety reviews for emerging technologies.
  • Own responsibility as the expert on the process technology and key deliverables of the Process Design Package PDP that will be the basis for commercial design and engineering or toll manufacturing.

Additional Responsibilities and Activities

  • Identify and evaluate innovative and disruptive technologies through interaction with technology licensors, participation in events associated with bio-based chemical technologies, and review of international publications.
  • Carry out techno-economic assessments, actively participating in the preparation and/or technical review of mass and energy balances, PFDs, Capex and Opex estimates, among others.
  • Work with different teams within Braskem (eg process engineering, biotech and catalysis, sustainability, innovation, intellectual property, etc.) to guarantee the successful development of projects.
  • Collaborate with universities, start-ups and technology hubs seeking new technologies that may be of interest to Braskem.

Requirements

  • B S in Chemical Engineering or relevant field (PhD is a plus) with a strong background in new technology development
  • 10+ years (including graduate research) experience in bioprocess engineering
  • Demonstrated experience in process development and scale-up for fermentation technology with implementation of new technology at industrial scale
  • Demonstrated expertise using process simulation software (eg SuperPro or Aspen Plus)
  • Experience in pilot plant and/or demo plant operations
  • Experience with microbial, aseptic aerobic fermentation in stainless steel SIP fermenters
  • Strong technical judgement to assess project decisions and timetables
  • Ability and seniority to ensure good interpersonal relationships and people management, to work on projects with internal and external interfaces
  • Have a working knowledge of intellectual property
  • English and Portuguese fluency is required

Location: Hybrid mode with a home site of Campinas, Brazil to ensure a close working relationship with research teams at the Braskem Tech Centers.

Job details

  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Full-time
  • Job function: Engineering and Information Technology
  • Industries: Plastics Manufacturing

Sobre a ODONTOCLINIC

Na Odontoclinic, somos movidos por pessoas e por sorrisos. Somos uma empresa feita de gente que gosta de gente. Aqui, acreditamos no poder da atitude, da ação e da paixão por encantar. Nosso time é formado por profissionais que não apenas vestem a camisa, mas têm atitude de dono, colocam a mão na massa e fazem acontecer todos os dias.

Com mais de 28 anos de história, construímos a maior rede de franquias odontológicas do Brasil. São mais de 180 clínicas em todo o país, mais de 1 milhão de sorrisos cuidados com carinho e cerca de 9 mil atendimentos realizados por dia. Tudo isso é possível porque temos um time incrível por trás de cada resultado.

Somos a primeira rede de franquias odontológicas do país e, ao longo dos anos, já recebemos reconhecimentos como o Troféu Excelência em Franchising da ABF e como uma das Melhores Franquias do Brasil pela revista Pequenas Empresas & Grandes Negócios. Também fomos eleitos, por seis anos consecutivos, como a clínica com o melhor atendimento do Brasil no segmento odontológico pelo Reclame Aqui.

Aqui, acreditamos que o desenvolvimento de pessoas é o caminho para construir resultados sustentáveis. Investimos constantemente em treinamentos, programas de capacitação e iniciativas que potencializam o crescimento pessoal e profissional dos nossos colaboradores. Acreditamos no poder da educação continuada como alicerce para inovação, performance e encantamento.

A Odontoclinic oferece um ambiente acolhedor, diverso e cheio de oportunidades. Se você tem espírito empreendedor, gosta de desafios e quer fazer parte de algo grande, vem ser Odontocliniquer!

description:
Overview

O Técnico de Instalação de Cabeamento é responsável pela execução de serviços de instalação, manutenção e testes em sistemas de cabeamento estruturado e soluções de conectividade. Atua diretamente em campo, garantindo que as instalações atendam aos padrões técnicos, normas de segurança e requisitos de qualidade do Grupo Facimus.

Principais Atividades

  • Realizar instalação, manutenção e testes em redes de cabeamento estruturado (metálico e óptico) em clientes corporativos.
  • Executar passagem de cabos, montagem de racks, patch panels, DIO, CTOs e pontos de rede e infraestrutura seca (postes, dutos, canaletas e estruturas prediais).
  • Interpretar projetos técnicos e diagramas para execução das atividades.
  • Realizar certificação de cabos e aferição de qualidade da rede instalada (OTDR, power meter, light source).

  • Prestar suporte técnico em campo, solucionando problemas relacionados a cabeamento.
  • Manter registros atualizados das atividades realizadas em checklist.
  • Zelar pelo veículo, ferramentas e equipamentos fornecidos pela empresa.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

Competências Específicas

  • Conhecimento em cabeamento estruturado (metálico e óptico)
  • Execução de instalações e manutenções de acordo com normas técnicas
  • Leitura e interpretação de projetos técnicos; Tradução correta de diagramas em instalações físicas
  • Certificação e testes de cabos; Relatórios técnicos de qualidade das instalações realizadas
  • Normas de segurança do trabalho; Atuação em conformidade com padrões de segurança
  • Uso de ativos e ferramentas específicas de instalação; Operação correta de equipamentos de medição e instalação

title: Senior Systems Analyst (IBM Power Systems)
description:
Role and Responsibilities

  • Interact with Global Managed Services (GMS) customers daily in support of the environments managed by GMS – hosted or remote by
    • Resolving environment-related problems reported by GMS customers through CSS as assigned
    • Completing service requests submitted by GMS customers, including managing customer user IDs, remote print writers and/or queues, and similar requests
    • Submitting service requests for data center services needed by GMS customers
    • Acting as a liaison between GMS customer and Netcracker IT Group to facilitate the completion of requests
    • Researching system and database journals to retrieve auditing information in support of internal and customer data investigations
    • Troubleshooting problems with TCP/IP-based interfaces using IBM and third-party network tracing tools
  • Configure and monitor systems to ensure
    • peak and problem-free operation
    • compliance with security standards
  • Configure and support
    • Software-based replication, particularly using Vision Solutions MIMIX HA1, as it relates to both HA and DR implementations.
    • System monitoring, particularly using Help Systems Halcyon, especially as it relates to interface/job monitoring
    • Tape management systems, particularly using IBM’s BRMS.
    • System compliance and audit functions, particularly using Enforcive Enterprise Security, especially as it relates to PCI compliance
    • Automation functions, particularly using Help Systems Robot SCHEDULE and REPLAY, or IBM’s Advanced Job Scheduler
    • Browser-based GUI interface, particularly using Rocket Software’s LegaSuite application over Netcracker’s ICOMS solution.
    • Digital certificates using IBM Digital Certificate Manager
    • End user access to system tools using IBM i Navigator
  • Maintain application environments by
    • Reviewing patches and release updates and constructing a plan to apply them to Netcracker and third party applications
    • Creating custom programming using CL, RPG, or other available languages in support of production processing
    • Performing regular maintenance tasks on time to ensure PCI compliance
  • Regularly review
    • Security bulletins issued by US-CERT, IBM, and other vendors, especially related to PCI compliance. Resolve any vulnerabilities on time
    • System performance statistics, forecasted growth data, and project system resource utilization, making recommendations for hardware and/or software upgrades to meet demand.
    • Disaster Recovery Plans and participate in annual Disaster Recovery Exercises, focusing on validating business continuity plans for GMS customers. Update the DR plans to reflect current configurations, environments, and processes.
  • Manage the underlying systems supporting the ICOMS solution by
    • Upgrading firmware, and HMC release levels in accordance with IBM compatibility matrices and recommendations
    • Allocating system resources for production and test partitions
    • Preparing system plans for partitions on Power Systems servers
    • Installing hardware components required by the solution
    • Reading the PAL and SAL in System Service Tools (SST) and Service logs in the HMC to assist hardware maintenance providers with troubleshooting, and resolving hardware problems.
  • Will be asked to perform similar duties for internal (development/test) systems as well.
  • May be asked to perform consulting services for customers outside of GMS

Required Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years experience (preferably more) administering IBM i running on Power Systems servers.
    • Must be familiar with all aspects of system administration, including upgrades from previous releases, backup and recovery, storage management, using journaling, understands the differences between various types of ASPs and their uses, and has strong HMC skills.
  • IBM Certified System Administrator - IBM i 7.x (highly preferred)
  • At least one major system hardware upgrade (for example POWER6 to POWER7)
  • At least two major operating system upgrades (for example, IBM i 5.4 or 6.1 to 7.1)
  • At least two full system restores (as if from a site-down crash)
  • Experience in managing partitioned systems
  • Strong experience in using database journaling, especially remote journaling
  • Strong experience with utilizing Performance tools such as IBM Job Watcher/Pex and MPG Performance Navigator
  • Understands the differences between independent ASPs, *SYSBAS, and traditional ASPs
  • Understands the functional differences between logical replication and clustering
  • Understands IBM i security administration, compliance, and access control
  • Extensive knowledge of the HMC
  • Some experience managing IBM i with SAN-attached storage
  • Keeps up with IBM hardware announcements, and has an awareness of IBM technical directions for their product lines
  • Keeps up with Technology Refreshes, and has an awareness of new features and functions
  • Is very familiar with the IBM Memo to Users for V7R1 as of April 2012, and any subsequent Technical Releases (TRs)
  • Ability to train operations monitoring staff on how to respond to alerts, ensure “switch readiness” on HA/DR systems, and perform less complex maintenance window activities
  • Must be able to provide 24x7 on-call support coverage - on a rotational basis with other team members. (on occasion)

Other Highly Desired Skills

  • Experience installing software upgrades and updates to third party and in-house developed applications
  • Very familiar with the use of MIMIX software for logical replication of database information to redundant systems for high availability and disaster recovery deployments
  • Very familiar with the configuration and management of ODBC / JDBC / TCP socket communications on IBM i systems communicating with other applications running on Unix / Linux & or Windows systems
  • Very familiar with current PCI-DSS standards and how to ensure PCI compliance on IBM i operating system and database containing PCI sensitive data
  • Experience managing medium projects, lasting a few weeks, involving two or more teams.
  • Fluent English Speaker and availability to work from office on Hybrid mode
  • Must be able to work on Shifts mode

Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field

title: Experienced UVM Verification Engineer
description:
Are you willing to participate in the development of a human size growing team?

Aedvices specializes in ICs, FPGAs and embedded systems Front-End Digital Design and Design Verification. We provide flexible solutions to our customers, ranging from turnkey design and verification options to dedicated consulting in design or verification as well as training solutions.

Our customer base spans from large semiconductor groups to small tech startups.

We support a wide range of projects in the automotive, big-data, artificial intelligence and energy sectors, such as the verification of the telemetry system of a Mars probe / Mars tremors or the verification of a System-on-Chip for Bluetooth Low Energy.

To sustain our growth, we are looking for several experienced verification engineers to join the team.

Your main responsibilities

As a key member of the verification team, you will define the verification methodologies and adapt them to the project requirements. You will be responsible for the verification of complex IPs and System-On-Chips, the development of verification environments (SystemVerilog/UVM/other), UVM verification IPs (VIPs), and the writing of verification plans.

You propose improvements to existing flows. You will also have the opportunity to work with colleagues in France and with our partners on innovative approaches and methodologies (formal methods, PSS).

Is the job right for you?

To carry out your missions, you need to master several essential technical topics:

  • Functional verification at IP level and of complex SoC,
  • SystemVerilog testbench and UVM core development,
  • Development of verification plans,
  • AMBA protocols,
  • Embedded software development (C, C++),
  • Knowledge of RTL design languages: VHDL, Verilog,
  • Written and spoken English.

Other skills welcome:

  • Object Oriented Programming,
  • Advanced protocols such as PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, Bluetooth, …
  • ASIC and FPGA design,
  • Scripting (Python).

For an efficient and fruitful collaboration, we expect you to:

  • Have an engineering background or equivalent, and at least 5 years’ experience in verification,
  • Be able to balance perfectionism and pragmatism!
  • Be eager to learn new things, grow your skills and elaborate creative technical solutions,
  • Be able to work in a team,
  • Think “problem solving” and think “out of the box”,
  • And last but not least: be committed to customers’ satisfaction.

What we offer you

  • Continue to develop your expertise with the access of all our training materials,
  • Join a friendly company who share values of Diversity, Conviviality, Technical Expertise and Passion,
  • Benefit from a flexible organization with the possibility of remote work,
  • Full time contract,
  • Additional benefits such as meal voucher and dental health.

Want to join us?

Our recruitment process is simple:

After an initial call, you’ll meet with Agnès, our HR Manager, and Eric, our Verification Technical Director.

If your expectations match ours, the recruitment process concludes with a meeting with Fabio, our Brazil director.

Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We’re powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you’re interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

Torizon is a Linux-based industrial IoT platform that simplifies modern iterative development, maintenance, and operation of distributed edge devices. It is a scalable full-stack DevOps-oriented solution, seamlessly integrating device hardware & software (including a Linux OS), development tools, cloud-based remote updates & fleet management, for high reliability and security applications.

Job Description

As a Junior Product Manager – Software , you will be part of the Product & Technology ( P&T ) group, supporting the definition and execution of the product vision for Toradex’s software stack — from embedded Linux to cloud-based tools. You will work closely with senior PMS, engineering, marketing, and customer-facing teams to help ensure our software offerings deliver value and align with customer and market needs.

This role is ideal for someone early in their product management career who wants to grow into a strong, technical product leader. You’ll learn how to balance strategy and execution, and gain hands-on experience with embedded and IoT technologies.

  • Support senior Product Managers in defining and maintaining the product roadmap.
  • Participate in market research, competitive analysis, and customer interviews.
  • Translate customer and business needs into product requirements and user stories.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams during planning, development, and release cycles.
  • Help coordinate software release notes, documentation, and internal product communication.
  • Track and analyze product KPIs, usage data, and customer feedback.
  • Contribute to improving product management processes and tools.

Desired Candidate Profile

Mandatory:

  • Proactive attitude and willingness to learn.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.
  • Basic understanding of software development processes or lifecycle.
  • Analytical thinking and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional, multicultural teams.
  • Previous experience (internship, trainee, or 1–2 years) in product management, software development, or related roles.

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with Agile or Scrum practices.
  • Understanding of embedded systems, Linux, or IoT technologies.
  • Understanding of Software as a Service (SaaS) technologies.
  • Experience working with developer tools, issue trackers (e.g., Jira), or analytics dashboards.

Willing to learn:

  • Product management techniques and tools, including helping the PM Team with their implementation.
  • Business and technical aspects of embedded Linux and cloud-connected devices.
  • Data-driven decision-making for software products.
  • Communication with stakeholders across technical and non-technical domains.

What we offer

  • Agile, globally oriented, and inter-cultural corporate culture.
  • Exposure to leading-edge embedded and IoT technologies.
  • Flat hierarchy where you can shape and influence your work processes.
  • Mentorship and learning opportunities from experienced Product Managers and engineers.
  • Variety of knowledge-sharing, training, and self-development opportunities.
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space, and a flexible working environment.
  • Opportunities for career growth into more senior Product Management roles.
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

title: Product Security Engineer
description:
Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We’re powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you’re interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

Overview

As a Product Security Engineer at Toradex, you’ll be responsible for the implementation, validation, and maintenance of security features in Toradex’s embedded software stack. That means hands‑on, low‑level work with bootloaders, Linux kernel security features, secure software updates and more.

We aim to make embedded software development easy and approachable, which means that our engineers have to go beyond just feature enablement. Your work will involve making the developer experience of working with low‑level security features as smooth as it possibly can be. You’ll work on systems used in critical industries like healthcare, industrial automation, and robotics.

Responsibilities

  • Security feature enablement: Bring up security features on new hardware. Every new product we release, we strive to have a uniform, straightforward experience for enabling basic hardware security features like secure boot, ARM TrustZone/ OP-TEE , and hardware‑backed encryption.
  • System-level hardening: Toradex maintains Torizon OS, a secure, production‑ready embedded Linux OS. Making sure that security features fit into the whole stack, and that configurations are secure‑by‑default for the most common and supported workflows is a key part of the job. Understanding how everything fits together is a must.
  • Vulnerability management: Monitor upstream CVEs, assess their impact on Toradex products and their likely impact on Toradex customers' products. Apply patches and mitigations. Help draft security advisories and write VEX documents. Work on and maintain internal tooling for vulnerability management.
  • Security testing and automation: Automate test coverage of security features. Familiarity with LAVA or other hardware‑in‑the‑loop embedded testing methodologies and frameworks is a strong plus.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience
  • 3+ years of experience in embedded systems security or adjacent areas (e.g. Linux security engineering)
  • Hands‑on experience with bootloaders (e.g., U-Boot), kernel security features, and embedded Linux distributions/build systems (Yocto/OpenEmbedded, buildroot, etc.)
  • Solid C/C++ coding and debugging skills
  • Experience with automating security checks in CI/CD pipelines
  • Knowledge of threat modeling/risk modeling methodologies and how they relate to regulatory and standards compliance is a plus
  • Knowledge of security evaluation and analysis tools like fuzzers and static analysis tools is a plus

What we offer

  • Agile, globally oriented and intercultural corporate culture.
  • Work on the latest hardware technology with early access to major SoC vendor
  • Enjoy a flat hierarchy where you may truly shape our hardware and software offerings
  • Count on a diverse team of experienced hardware and software engineers
  • Variety of knowledge sharing, training and self‑development opportunities
  • The opportunity to play a key role in shaping your own work processes and your work environment.
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment.
  • Opportunities for your personal development.
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature‑rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self‑driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We’re powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. If you’re interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

We develop Torizon, which is a Linux-based industrial IoT platform that simplifies modern iterative development, maintenance, and operation of distributed edge devices. It is a scalable full-stack DevOps-oriented solution, seamlessly integrating device hardware & software (including a Linux OS), development tools, cloud-based remote updates & fleet management, for high reliability and security applications.

  • Write and update Debian packages for downstream SoC vendor packages.

title: Arquiteto de Engenharia de Software
description:
Overview

Fazemos parte do Grupo BTG Pactual, maior banco de investimento da américa latina. Nosso propósito é transformar ativos desvalorizados no mercado de crédito e real estate. Atuamos na gestão de créditos inadimplentes corporativos, ajudando fundos, investidores, instituições financeiras e empresas a encontrarem soluções estratégicas para seus negócios. Isso é possível, devido às nossas 4 verticais: Créditos Inadimplidos Coorporativos (NPL), Ativos Imobiliários Estressados (DRE), Recuperação Judicial e Falência e Dívida Ativa.

Principais destaques

Alguns dos nossos destaques:

  • Somos um dos maiores resultados do Grupo BTG Pactual.
  • Crescemos, em média, 20% ao ano.
  • Contamos com a ATENA, nossa IA que otimiza a rotina e potencializa análises.

Nossa comunidade é formada por 300 colaboradores e 170 parceiros, que atuam com proatividade, inovação, excelência, senso de dono e foco no cliente. Em um ambiente que valoriza o empreendedorismo, a meritocracia e o foco no cliente, promovemos uma cultura de resultados e crescimento profissional contínuo.

Utilizamos banco de dados PostgreSQL e com micro serviços desenvolvidos em Python (flask) e frontend em Angular. Toda nossa estrutura é “dockerizada” rodando em kubernetes e integrada utilizando tópicos (SNS) e filas (SQS). Também fazemos uso do Elasticsearch para otimizar nossas consultas. Tudo sendo provido pela AWS. Também temos toda uma esteira de CI/CD com testes automatizados provido pela Microsoft Azure Devops.

Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter microsserviços em Python (Flask ou FastAPI), garantindo alta performance, segurança e escalabilidade;
  • Contribuir para a arquitetura técnica e para o desenho de soluções que traduzam demandas de negócio em sistemas robustos e eficientes;
  • Implantar integrações e automações utilizando o ecossistema AWS (EventBridge, SQS, RDS, Lambda, S3, entre outros);
  • Atuar na observabilidade e sustentação de aplicações em ambiente Kubernetes, com foco em confiabilidade e resiliência;
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares (produto, dados e negócios) para evoluir continuamente a plataforma tecnológica da Enforce;
  • Participar ativamente de decisões técnicas e estratégicas de arquitetura e infraestrutura.

Requisitos

  • +8 anos de experiência em engenharia de software, utilizamos Python e frameworks modernos (Flask, FastAPI ou similares) mas caso você venha do Java e tenha desejo de trabalhar com nossa stack não será problema;
  • Vivência em ambientes baseados em microsserviços e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Experiência sólida com AWS (preferencialmente EventBridge, SQS, Lambda, RDS e S3);
  • Conhecimentos em orquestração de containers com Kubernetes;
  • Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas de alta qualidade;
  • Perfil colaborativo, com iniciativa e foco em resultados.

Diferenciais

  • Familiaridade com práticas DevOps e CI/CD.

Selecione a frequência (em dias) de recebimento de alertas:

Nós acreditamos que a energia que você dedica à sua carreira merece retorno. Por isso, reconhecemos a dedicação das nossas pessoas e estamos sempre em busca de quem deseja fazer a diferença e construir uma trajetória próspera e segura.

Na CPFL, você encontra um ambiente sólido para crescer com confiança, com segurança para evoluir e espaço para construir um futuro com propósito.

Modelo de trabalho: Presencial.

Empresa: CPFL Brasil – Uma empresa do Grupo CPFL Energia.

  • Ensino superior completo, preferencialmente em direito ou economia;
  • Necessária experiência com regulação e comercialização, com foco em geração e mercado livre de energia;
  • Necessário conhecimento aprofundado acerca do arcabouço legal/regulatório do Setor Elétrico;
  • Diferencial conhecimento de estrutura tarifária;
  • Necessário inglês avançado (utilização no dia a dia para reuniões e elaboração de apresentações);
  • Disponibilidade para atuar 100% presencial em Campinas/SP.

O seu dia a dia:

  • Monitorar continuamente alterações legais, infralegais e regulatórias, analisando documentos de ANEEL, MME, CCEE, ONS, EPE e agências estaduais, para identificar riscos e oportunidades para os negócios.
  • Realizar análises técnicas dos impactos regulatórios sobre ativos e produtos, utilizando modelos e dados setoriais, com o objetivo de propor ajustes e mitigadores, além de identificar oportunidades, quando houver.
  • Elaborar e revisar contribuições técnicas para participações públicas, assegurando alinhamento institucional e profundidade técnica dos argumentos.
  • Colaborar com a elaboração de manifestações e recursos administrativos, junto a órgãos reguladores, garantindo o cumprimento de prazos e a defesa dos interesses da empresa.
  • Analisar preços, encargos setoriais e projeções tarifárias, utilizando ferramentas analíticas para avaliar impactos no Ambiente de Contratação Livre (ACL).
  • Representar tecnicamente a empresa em fóruns, grupos de trabalho e associações setoriais, defendendo posicionamentos estratégicos e promovendo articulação institucional.
  • Analisar e propor ajustes regulatórios aplicáveis aos produtos de comercialização, com foco em competitividade, inovação e conformidade.
  • Interpretar normativos regulatórios aplicáveis a projetos de geração, incluindo temas de conexão e transmissão, para orientar áreas técnicas e jurídicas.
  • Contribuir com o planejamento estratégico regulatório do grupo, propondo ações e metas alinhadas à agenda institucional.
  • Apoiar áreas internas com pareceres regulatórios especializados, assegurando segurança jurídica e técnica nas decisões corporativas.
  • Desenvolver materiais executivos para alta liderança, traduzindo temas regulatórios complexos em linguagem acessível e estratégica.
  • Fortalecer o relacionamento com stakeholders estratégicos, atuando como referência técnica e institucional em temas regulatórios.

Informações Adicionais / O que esperamos de você:

  • Capacidade Técnica: Conhecimento da estrutura regulatória do setor elétrico e suas alterações, com foco nas regras de comercialização de energia no Brasil.
  • Análise Crítica: Habilidade para identificar riscos e oportunidades de negócios a partir das mudanças regulatórias, propondo e negociando melhorias na regulação do setor elétrico e nas regras de comercialização de energia.
  • Comunicação Eficaz: Competência para acompanhar publicações relevantes no DOU e pautas regulatórias nas Reuniões da Diretoria da ANEEL, além de representar os negócios não regulados do Grupo CPFL junto às autoridades competentes e associações de agentes de mercado.
  • Colaboração e Influência: Capacidade de suportar a construção de contribuições às consultas públicas, tomadas de subsídios e demais atos regulatórios relacionados ao Setor Elétrico, interagindo com a Diretoria Executiva do grupo CPFL e áreas internas clientes.
  • Proatividade e Inovação: Elaboração de estudos e pareceres regulatórios para diversas áreas dos negócios não regulados, clientes, fornecedores e públicos diversos, sempre buscando maximizar o resultado consolidado do Grupo CPFL.

O que oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Licença maternidade 6 meses e paternidade 20 dias
  • Auxílio creche (conforme regras de elegibilidade);
  • Wellhub;
  • Programa Fale Comigo (assessoria gratuita e sigilosa via telefone para auxílio psicológico, jurídico, financeiro, social).

Conheça um pouco sobre nós:

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.

Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI GrowthGroup

ABI’s Growth Group is the center of innovation and tech development within ABI, which is driving ABI’s growth by developing innovations for the core beer business and creating new hyper-growth tech businesses.

ABI Growth includes the following business lines: BEES (our business-to-business e-commerce and SaaS business, also focused on new technologies), TaDa and Ze Delivery (our direct-to-consumer e-commerce businesses), and several other high-tech divisions, including fintech and venture capital.

description:
Overview

Em 2017, a Companhia deu início à sua trajetória de investimentos com a aquisição do Hospital Vera Cruz, localizado em Campinas-SP. Com mais de 80 anos de história, o hospital é um dos mais tradicionais da cidade. Atualmente, o Hospital Vera Cruz conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 120 leitos de internação, 30 leitos de UTI, maternidade e pronto atendimento 24h. Além disso, oferece atendimento em mais de 66 especialidades médicas e possui Acreditação ONA 3, estando em processo de preparação para a certificação JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Hospital Vera Cruz, expandimos significativamente nossa rede em Campinas e região. Isso inclui a inauguração de novos serviços, como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia e a Unidade de Atenção Primária à Saúde, além da criação de unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba. Também adquirimos a Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais emblemáticos da cidade, instalado em um prédio centenário que faz parte do patrimônio particular local. No mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2care. Essas aquisições reforçam as consolidações da nossa região, que fazem parte do grupo Hospital Care. Fundado em 2017, o Hospital Care nasceu da união de pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar no Brasil. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde, com um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, focado no equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Nosso sistema de saúde é completo, com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia, estamos presentes em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais de gestão de saúde, nos estados de São Paulo, Paraná e Santa Catarina. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos consolidar como a principal Rede de Prestadores de Serviços de Saúde do Brasil.

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams.   • Bachelor’s degree in Design, Graphic Design, Digital Design, Visual Design, Product Design, or Industrial Design.

  • Experience in creating polished presentations, using storytelling techniques and illustrations.
  • Solid understanding of UX, UI, prototyping, and usability best practices.
  • Proficiency with Figma and Adobe Family (Photoshop / Illustrator), and familiarity with tools like Lucidchart, Maze, or similar.
  • Ability to clearly articulate and defend design decisions using data, benchmarks, and empathy for diverse audiences.
  • Experience working in agile environments, collaborating with Product, Engineering, and other Designers.
  • Intermediate or advanced English for global collaboration.

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with discovery frameworks, product metrics, and A/B testing.
  • Knowledge of accessibility and inclusive design principles.

Role Overview

The ITOps Analyst will handle all IT operational needs at BotCity (excluding product, engineering, and InfoSec), covering tasks from user provisioning to device management to infrastructure support.
